verdict.rationale: No direct documentation states Angular renders real DOM for devtools debugging, but community evidence indicates it integrates directly with DOM-manipulating libraries like D3 without bridges, implying real DOM output rather than a virtual DOM abstraction (angular-comm-2). This is only indirect corroboration; missing for 10: explicit docs/tutorials on inspecting Angular components in browser devtools, first-party statements about real DOM rendering, and independent hands-on confirmation of devtools workflow.
